name: mdlearn
description: Turn class files and notes into compiler-checked, spaced-repetition lessons.
author: Teo Clerk

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mdlearn/core && npm run build -w @mdlearn/studio && npm run build -w mdlearn && npm run build -w @mdlearn/mcp
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli --noEmit && tsc -p packages/mcp --noEmit && tsc -p packages/studio/tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/studio/tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p packages/desktop
scripts.publish:npm: npm run build && npm test && npm publish -w @mdlearn/core -w @mdlearn/mcp -w @mdlearn/studio -w mdlearn --access public
